defaults.distinction: Cut0 is the intrinsic step energy-deposit filter, separate from the 0.7mm secondary production range cut. No additional analysis energy threshold.

sensitive_response.scope: One sector/layer diagnostic only, same original logical layer and materials, one event excluded from all response/calibration samples.

tail_definition.convention: E_Si/requested gun kinetic energy; strict f_visible<cut for all energies/points/geometries

seed_provenance.mode: Explicit native /random/setSeeds perblock; no EventSeeder action

execution.rss_measurement: Maximum terminated child RSS from getrusage; fresh controller process, DDsim transport child

tail_definition.conditional_intervals: Wilson95% from fixed observed calibration cut; joint bootstrap additionally varies the independent reference cut; bootstrap intervals do not replace Wilson upper bounds at zero tail count.

joint_tail_bootstrap.convention: Independent event resampling per sample; each replicate shares the same independent calibration-cut resample across all samples. Sample order labels both covariance axes.
joint_tail_bootstrap.caveat: An observed zero tail may have zero bootstrap variance; Wilson95 upper bounds remain required.

tiled.overlap_scope: Complete logical layer; retained sector/layer/frame transforms are source-identical. Full-detector overlap acceptance is not claimed.

continuous.overlap_scope: Complete logical layer; retained sector/layer/frame transforms are source-identical. Full-detector overlap acceptance is not claimed.

limitations: Independent unpaired populations; no event covariance across geometry cases.
Continuous sheet adds silicon and activates guards while retaining nonuniform module electronics: not a pure readout segmentation comparison.
Other detector subsystems/opposite end absent; raw visible spread is not reconstructed resolution or detector acceptance.
Undefined zero-denominator widths/bootstrap replicates are retained as null with explicit counts.
